title: Quick
body:
This mod allows you to open a radial menu with a keybind (V by default), and register custom actions for items via datapack or data components.

Currently it lets you use the following items without having them in the hotbar:

*   Elytra
*   Eye of Ender
*   Ender Pearl
*   Splash Potion
*   Lingering Potion
*   Wind Charge
*   Firework Rocket
*   Snowball
*   Egg
*   Blue Egg
*   Brown Egg

The wiki is available at [https://ofekn-mods.github.io/quick/](https://ofekn-mods.github.io/quick/) Also you're welcome to join the [discord server](https://discord.gg/eTn5zzrWKa) if you have any questions or suggestions
